string.text: Basic Tools
This box contains a set of various tools that can be used to work on weapons and armor. Only a technician would know how to use this effectively.
Advanced Tools
This box contains a set of various tools and other items that can be used to do sophisticated work on weapons and armor. Only a technician would know how to use this effectively.
Expert Tools
This box contains a set of various complicated looking tools and other items that can be used to perform complex work on weapons and armor. Only a technician would know how to use this effectively.
